Container.Name: tiktok-collections
Container.Overview: Automatically monitor and download TikTok collections. Syncs your saved TikTok videos to local storage with organized folder structure. Runs on a configurable schedule to keep your collection up to date.
Container.Description: Automatically monitor and download TikTok collections. Syncs your saved TikTok videos to local storage with organized folder structure.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port to access the web viewer (maps to container port 8425)

Config.Name: Viewer Container Port
Config.Description: Internal container port for viewer server (must match Port Target above)

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Path to store config.json with your TikTok session credentials

Config.Name: Downloads Directory
Config.Description: Path where TikTok videos will be downloaded

Config.Name: TikTok Session ID
Config.Description: Your TikTok sessionid cookie (get from browser DevTools). Required for authentication.

Config.Name: Sync Interval (minutes)
Config.Description: How often to check for new videos (in minutes)

Config.Name: Download Limit
Config.Description: Limit downloads per sync cycle (e.g., 5 for testing). Leave empty for unlimited.

Config.Name: Full Sync
Config.Description: Force full sync of all collections (fetch ALL pages, not just recent ~30)

Config.Name: Fetch All Favorites
Config.Description: Fetch ALL favorited videos using API pagination on startup (one-time operation)
